subject: Discrepancy in credit note VEN042-0024
body:
Dear Evergreen Infra Private Limited team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found a discrepancy for invoice VEN042-0024 dated 30 Sep 2025. The Supplier's GSTR-2B line shows Rs 170 of tax while the invoice shows Rs 164. The Supplier reported more credit than was booked, affecting Rs 7 of input tax credit.

Please amend your return or correct the booking and confirm once done.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
